cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: Sikafloor® Level TOP is a high flowing self-levelling underlayment used to level concrete substrates prior to the installation of flooring.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer

Levelling of uneven concrete
Suitable for new or old internal concrete substrates

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2026, Version 04.10) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment
s: Concrete floors should be fully cured, structurally sound, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates and dust for Eg. Concrete must be porous and accept water penetration.

Test by lightly sprinkling water on various areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with a selected primer can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed by the concrete surface contaminants are present then loss of adhesion may occur. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed before installation.

Concrete must be free of efflorescence and not subject to hydrostatic pressure. If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) and moisture sensitive flooring is being installed Sikafloor® Moisture Barrier System may be considered (Sikafloor®-158W Fast Barrier + Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact + Sikafloor® Level Top).
Contact your local Sika® office for further information.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Priming
s: Refer to the primer product data sheet for additional specific instructions
Chosen primer shall be completely dry prior to the application of SikaFloor® Levelling Systems

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Priming > Porous Priming
s: Sikafloor® 01 Primer @ 1:1 - 1:2 - 1:3 with water
or
Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer - undiluted (neat)
tr: Note: Correct amount of priming liquid should always be applied to the prepared substrate giving good penetration and film build. Thin applications may result in pinholing or debonding levelling compound from the substrate. Do Not Allow primer to pool while drying. On particularly porous (mechanically prepared) surfaces or where the initial prime coat absorbs immediately a second coat is recommended. Average dry time ~20–30 min (per coat)

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Priming > Non-Porous Priming
s: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime – do not dilute
tr: Note: When applying primer to Non-porous surface use a paint roller and apply one thin even coat.
Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact Must Be Completely Dry (50 min+) prior to applying Sikafloor® products.

cl.t: Priming - High Moisture Content Concrete Priming
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Priming > High Moisture Content Concrete Priming
s: SikaFloor® 158W Fast Barrier followed by SikaFloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact
Apply the SikaFloor®- 158 Fast Barrier and allow to dry. Then apply a single coat of SikaFloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact and allow to dry prior to subsequent application of Sikafloor® Level TOP.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2026, Version 04.10) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information
s: Mixing ratio: 4.8 - 5 Litres of clean, cool water
Yield: ~12 litre per bag (4m² @ 3mm)
Layer thickness: 1 - 30mm or 10 - 50mm when bulked with 1-2mm aggregate
Pot Life: 18 minutes @ 23°C
Initial set time: 55-95 minutes at 23°C & 50% relative humidity
Final set time: 60-100 minutes at 23°C & 50% relative humidity

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Waiting time to overcoating
cl.x: Allow 18 hours at 23°C prior to the application of impervious floor coverings. Drying is dependent on thickness of application, temperature, air flow & relative humidity. Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Equipment
s: High speed heavy duty electric drill with stirrer attachment
Suitable size bucket - 20Lt+
Purpose built mechanical pump
Multi-bag mixing station
Personal protective equipment

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: Not mixing for the recommended time or additional water may result in product finish irregularities and possible failure.
Only mix Sikafloor® Level TOP in full bags and not part bags.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing > Single Bag Mixing
s: Mix the entire 20kg bag of powder with 4.8 - 5 Litres of clean, cool water. Slowly add powder to the water while mixing with a suitable electric drill and mixing paddle. Thoroughly mix at high speed for 2 minutes to a lump free consistency.

When extending the Sikafloor® Level TOP with aggregate (bulking out purposes) add ~10kg of clean 1-2mm aggregate with 20kg of Sikafloor® Level TOP and thoroughly mix at high speed for 2 minutes to a lump free consistency.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing > Multi Bag mixing Station
cl.x: Pre-measure the correct amount of water for the number of bags being mixed. Add the water to the mixing station then slowly add the powder to the water while mixing. Ensure the product is thoroughly mixed for a minimum of 2 minutes from the last bag added to the mixing station.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing > Pump Machine Application
cl.x: Ensure pump machines are calibrated to avoid over watering of the mixture.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application
s: Pour or Pump Sikafloor® Level Top, then spread with a long handled gauged spreader or trowel to heights as required. Sikafloor® Level Top will seek its own level during the first 12 minutes. For touch-ups, use a flat steel trowel.
For best results use a spike roller as necessary.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water product the the material drying.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Limitations Of Use
s: Do not install Sikafloor® Level TOP over particleboard, hardwood floors, parquet floors or metal. Sikafloor® Level TOP is only suitable for concrete substrates.
Do not mix or apply Sikafloor® Level TOP in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions.
Keep product cool prior to mixing and do not leave bags in direct sun for extended periods.
Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing.
All construction/expansion joints in existing concrete must be reflected through Sikafloor® product as soon as possible to do so.
Do not use on sloped surfaces that require drainage (wet areas).
Do not use in exterior applications.
Sikafloor® Level TOP is an underlayment and not designed to be left exposed. Apply a suitable floor covering over Sikafloor® Level TOP once the product has dried.

cl.x: Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clauses 5.2 to 5.3 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits.
